verdict.rationale: Twenty documents auto-generated GraphQL and REST API documentation per workspace that adapts to the custom data model. It also offers an interactive playground for executing real calls against your data, which covers the core of an explorable reference with runnable examples. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the playground's features (e.g. code snippets or copyable examples), independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground, and a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec (the probe found 404s at standard docs paths).
